summary: The change sets a default permission for file uploads, which could help resolve permission inconsistencies.

issues.description: The change does not address the underlying issue of permission differences between MemoryUploadedFile and TemporaryUploadedFile. It only sets a default permission, which may not fully resolve the problem.

The change introduces a new default value for FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS, which is consistent with the style of the surrounding code but could benefit from a comment explaining the rationale behind the choice.
